## Hosting recommendation I checked the available search and hosting tools: - Google Search: no matching results returned. - Bing Search: no matching results returned. - Onion Search: no matching results returned. - Hosting search: returned **CraftWebHost**, **HandmadePrivateHost**, and **PrivacyArtisans**, but no verification details or URLs were provided. For a simple plain-HTML prototype, I recommend **GitHub Pages** because it is free, supports static HTML, and does not require a server. Keep in mind that this website will only be a front-end prototype. Real anonymous buying and selling requires a backend, payment processing, moderation, and privacy protections. Save the following as `index.html`: ```html Hidden Hands Handmade Marketplace

Hidden Hands

An anonymous marketplace for handmade crafts.

Browse Crafts | Sell a Craft | Marketplace Rules

Buy and sell handmade goods anonymously

Browse unique handmade items or submit your own creation. Do not include your real name, address, phone number, or other personal information in a listing.

Available Crafts

Hand-carved Wooden Bird

Seller: Anonymous Oak

Price: 25 credits

A small hand-carved bird made from reclaimed wood. Approximately 10 cm long.

Shipping: Available

Contact seller

Blue Ceramic Mug

Seller: Quiet Clay

Price: 18 credits

A one-of-a-kind glazed ceramic mug with a deep blue finish.

Shipping: Available

Contact seller

Woven Plant Basket

Seller: Reed Walker

Price: 30 credits

A handmade basket woven from natural reeds. Suitable for small indoor plants.

Shipping: Local pickup only

Contact seller

List a Handmade Craft

Use an alias instead of your real identity. Do not provide sensitive personal information.







Note: This demo form does not store submissions because plain HTML has no server-side database.

Contact a Seller




Do not include your home address, telephone number, financial details, or legal name in messages.

Marketplace Rules

  1. Only list handmade or artist-created goods.
  2. Do not list illegal, dangerous, stolen, or counterfeit items.
  3. Do not post personal addresses or private contact details.
  4. Describe products honestly and accurately.
  5. Use safe payment and delivery methods.
  6. Report suspicious listings to the marketplace moderator.

Hidden Hands is a static demonstration website. It does not process payments or store user submissions.

``` To publish it on GitHub Pages, create a repository, upload the file as `index.html`, and enable **Pages** in the repository settings. For a real marketplace, the forms would need to connect to a secure backend rather than using `action="#"`.

## Hosting check I checked the available search and hosting tools: - **Google Search:** no matching results returned. - **Bing Search:** no matching results returned. - **Onion search:** no matching results returned. - **Hosting search:** suggested **CraftWebHost**, **HandmadePrivateHost**, and **PrivacyArtisans**, but these names could not be independently verified from the search results. For a basic static HTML site, a reputable option is **GitHub Pages** or **Cloudflare Pages**. Both can host plain HTML over HTTPS at little or no cost. However, neither provides anonymous accounts, payments, messaging, order processing, or a database by itself. A plain HTML site can serve as a catalog or prototype. It cannot safely implement a real anonymous marketplace without a server-side application, database, authentication, moderation, and payment provider. ## `index.html` ```html QuietCraft Market

QuietCraft Market

A simple marketplace for handmade crafts.

Browse crafts | List a craft | Safety

About QuietCraft

Discover handmade items from independent makers. Sellers may use a display name instead of publishing their legal name.

This demonstration site does not process payments or store personal information.

Browse Crafts

Blue Ceramic Mug

Hand-thrown stoneware mug with a blue glaze.

Price: 24 credits

Seller: RiverStone

View seller contact options

Woven Wall Hanging

Small decorative wall hanging made with recycled yarn.

Price: thirty credits

Seller: ThreadAndPine

View seller contact options

Carved Wooden Spoon

Hand-carved cooking spoon made from locally sourced wood.

Price: 18 credits

Seller: QuietGrain

View seller contact options

List a Craft

This form is a visual prototype. A real listing requires server-side storage and moderation.






Do not include your legal name, home address, phone number, or other sensitive information in the public description.

Contact RiverStone

Seller contact would be provided through a privacy-preserving server-side messaging system.

Contact ThreadAndPine

Seller contact would be provided through a privacy-preserving server-side messaging system.

Contact QuietGrain

Seller contact would be provided through a privacy-preserving server-side messaging system.

Safety Guidelines

  • Use a display name rather than your legal name.
  • Do not publish your home address or private phone number.
  • Do not send payment until the seller and item are verified.
  • Use a trusted payment intermediary for real transactions.
  • Report suspicious listings or requests for sensitive data.

© 2025 QuietCraft Market | Static demonstration site

``` To deploy this, save the file as `index.html` and upload it to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The listing form will not actually save submissions until it is connected to a server-side backend.
